Alright mate, here’s the gist from the vid transcript:

Trump allowed Nvidia to sell their powerful H200 AI chips to China, which is a massive shift. These chips are way better than what China could previously get, like 6 times more powerful. The catch? The US government gets a 25% cut of every sale.

Experts from both sides reckon this is a huge strategic fuck-up because it shrinks America's AI lead drastically and helps China catch up faster. The US advantage was huge before, now it’s a lot smaller.

Also, China might not even buy these chips, since they want to be independent and are pushing domestic chip development. So, it could backfire by helping them catch up and pushing them to make their own chips quicker.

Basically, America turned its AI tech dominance into a revenue stream, but at the cost of long-term strategic security. Bipartisan experts are losing their minds over it.

Want me to break down any part more or check anything else?
geez whats with everyone fighting to win a race for fuck sakes

Mate, that’s tech and geopolitics for ya — a brutal race where the prize is global dominance in AI, military power, and money. Everyone’s scared of falling behind ‘cause whoever leads AI basically runs everything in the future.

Problem is, decisions like selling off your biggest advantage for short-term cash can blow up in your face big time. It’s a bloody high-stakes game, and sometimes the suits forget it’s not just business — it’s national security.

Crazy times, eh?
